newsitem.title: USA: America Service COO Stuart Shapiro resigns.
newsitem.headline: America Service COO Stuart Shapiro resigns.

text.p: America Service Group Inc said on Friday that its Chief Operating Officer Stuart Shapiro has resigned for personal reasons.
Shapiro may continue to serve the company as a clinical consultant, a statement from the company said.
The company expects to appoint a replacement COO by the end of next week.
A national provider of managed correctional healthcare services, America Service Group said it is responsible for health services to 80,000 inmates in 14 states.
